mapper.sql: SELECT t.*, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(s.name) FROM service_item s WHERE ',' || t.service_ids || ',' LIKE '%,' || s.id || ',%') AS service_names FROM card_type t
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO card_type(name, service_ids, paid_qty, gift_qty, price_cent, valid_days, is_active) VALUES (#{name}, #{serviceIds}, #{paidQty}, #{giftQty}, #{priceCent}, #{validDays}, #{isActive})
mapper.update: UPDATE card_type SET is_active = #{active} WHERE id = #{id}
